summary.text: Rebecca Perkins Kwoka is a Democratic state senator from Portsmouth, New Hampshire, who has represented District 21 since December 2020 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia's 2026 election page lists her as Senate Minority Leader, and her career experience includes working as a green energy lawyer.

paragraphs.text: Perkins Kwoka lives in Portsmouth, New Hampshire. She earned a bachelor's degree from Dartmouth College in 2004 and a J.D. from Cornell Law School in 2010.
Her career experience includes working as a green energy lawyer.
She assumed office in the State Senate on December 2, 2020, and in the 2025-2026 session serves on the Rules and Enrolled Bills Committee.
